task_instance: Audit and refactor the file layout of a small messy 'projects' frontend feature (route + feature folder + barrel) for navigation and ownership clarity, per the frontend-organization skill: identify route/screen/section owners, fix boundary leaks, curate the feature barrel, promote a trapped primitive to core/ui, and group components by domain.
evidence: Created a realistic 'before' sample under before/src: routes/projects.tsx (route that also rendered the screen), a projects feature with two candidate screen owners (ProjectsContainer, ProjectsView), flat leaf components (ProjectCard, ListHeader, DeleteProjectModal), a generic Button trapped in the feature, a hook useProjectsData, an index.ts doing 'export *' from every file, and a settings feature deep-importing projects/components/ProjectCard. Then produced the full deliverable: (1) AUDIT.md stating the three ownership layers before/after, the Red Flags found, the boundary leaks fixed, the per-change rationale, recommended ESLint enforcement, and a Litmus check; (2) a reorganized 'after' tree under after/src matching the skill's preferred pattern: route split into projects.tsx (URL contract + loader + auth) and projects.lazy.tsx (mounts the screen); single screen owner components/ProjectsLandingView/ProjectsLandingView.tsx with colocated useProjectsLandingViewModel.ts; leaves grouped into cards/, sections/, overlays/ (DeleteProjectModal renamed DeleteProjectOverlay); Button promoted to core/ui with a core/ui barrel; a curated features/projects/index.ts exporting only the screen, the view-model and the loader; settings no longer deep-importing projects internals. Verified with Grep over after/: zero 'export *' remain, zero cross-feature deep imports into projects/components, and every import resolves to a created file or barrel (route files import the curated @/features/projects barrel, leaves import @/core/ui, the view-model imports ../../api/projectsApi). The skill recommends 'git mv' to preserve history; no shell/git is available in this runtime, so files were re-created at new paths instead. This affects only git history preservation, which the skill itself permits falling back from; the structural/organization deliverable (the actual purpose of the skill) was fully produced and verified using only text read/write/edit. Files: before/ and after/ subtrees plus AUDIT.md in the work directory.
